Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

It is always a pleasure to work with you, and we are delighted to present our proposal for your component requirements. As a reliable supply partner, we pride ourselves on delivering excellent service and maintaining a comprehensive product range to keep your production running smoothly. 

For the requested volume, we can offer you a price of €5.74 per unit. This quote comes with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We trust this proposal meets your expectations and look forward to continuing our successful business relationship. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH

move.subject: Re: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
move.body:
Dear Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH team,

Thank you for your prompt response and the detailed quotation provided for the requested volume. We are very interested in establishing a streamlined approach for the entire fastener kit with a single partner to ensure consistent quality and simplify our internal processes. Let us know if this setup allows us to unlock a more competitive pricing structure or if a slightly higher total volume would be necessary to reach a mutually beneficial agreement.

We confirm a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year for 24 months. We want one partner for the complete kit, which bundles parts we buy from several suppliers today. Our kit calculation: at your own current prices (19 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8 at EUR 12.46/100; 21 x Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 at EUR 4.91/100; 23 x Washer ISO 7089 M12 at EUR 12.78/1000) plus the part you do not supply us yet (6 x Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 at today's EUR 37.64/100), the kit costs EUR 5.95. Your offer of EUR 5.74 is a 3.5% bundle discount for the whole kit on a multi-year single-source volume; we consider EUR 4.94 a fair kit price. That is about EUR 188,700 a year, around 5 times our current business with you. Our demand forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M16x60 8.8 is up +15.3% (fc:360011@2026-09). Our demand forecast for Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8 is up +9.0% (fc:360012@2026-09).

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (unit_price 4.94, payment_days 90, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.86, payment_days 14, contract_months 24; unit_price 4.91, payment_days 60, contract_months 24). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. We have already taken that volume change data into account. We appreciate your commitment to a binding volume of 30,000 kits per year and the opportunity to serve as your single-source partner for this bundle. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our main Angebot is a price of €5.55 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months. 

Building on your proposal for a 24-month contract and 14-day payment terms, we can offer a revised price of EUR 5.49 per kit. As an alternative, we can offer a price of €5.49 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, a contract term of 24 months. This represents a substantial discount from the individual component prices while ensuring the consistent quality and reliable supply you require. 

Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
